name: EuroAirport Basel-Mulhouse-Freiburg

runway.v: two runways: 15/33, 3,900 m by 60 m (the longest), and 07/25, 1,715 m by 60 m

customs.v: French customs 05:00-24:00 local (stated 0400-2300 UTC winter, one hour earlier in summer); Swiss customs from 05:15; immigration police 24 hours
customs.quote: Douanes / Customs FR : 0400-2300. Douanes / Customs S : 0415-2300.

curfew.v: general aviation may not land or take off between 2100 and 0500 UTC winter time (22:00-06:00 local all year); exceptions for ambulance, humanitarian, emergency, state and government flights
curfew.quote: LDG and TKOF forbidden between 2100 and 0500. (SUM : - 1 HR).

ppr.v: non-based VFR flights parking at the airport need prior permission from Apron Control 24 hours ahead
ppr.quote: subject to a PPR request and to FPL filing.

handling.v: handling compulsory for all non-based general aviation; AIP lists Swissport, Air France, Air Service Basel (ASB) and CGS
handling.quote: For safety and security reasons, handling is compulsory for all non-based general aviation flights.

slots.v: IATA Level 2 (schedules facilitated) since summer 2024, coordinated by COHOR
slots.quote: EuroAirport (MLH, BSL, EAP/LFSB) is designated as Level 2 airport, effective from the start of NS24.

missing: hours (only in a superseded AIP edition; current edition not read)
notes: Times in the French AIP are UTC winter; 'SUM : - 1 HR' means one hour earlier in UTC in summer, so local times stay the same all year (winter UTC+1, summer UTC+2). VAC text pages dated 06 AUG 2026 / 10 AUG 2023 (01 OCT 2026 edition). Geo, runway, hours and handling-agent names from AIP France AD 2 LFSB (AIRAC AMDT 06/25, 12 JUN 2025) as republished by DIRCAM. The handling quote covers the compulsory rule; agent names quoted from AD 2.4: '(1) SWISSPORT (2) AIR FRANCE (3) AIR SERVICE BASEL (ASB) (4) CGS'. COHOR level notice dated 6 Oct 2023; the current level was not rechecked. The airport sits in France; the EuroAirport operator site was not reached. Facts from the superseded edition other than runway, location and operator were not used (hours).
